summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the Special Needs Co-Parenting (SNC) Phase B/C wiring. Wrote 19 pytest API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_snc_api.py covering schema, assessment save/resume, single + bulk answer validation with type coercion, scoring, cached report lifecycle (cached=false -> cached=true -> stale after answer change -> regenerate clears stale), PDF download (application/pdf, >50KB, %PDF signature, 404 before generation), DELETE /me cascade to reports, and Family Report removal regression. All 19 tests pass. Frontend flow validated via Playwright: /special-needs renders snc-assessment-root, snc-progress-bar, 13 nav tabs, Likert click triggers 'Saved' toast, snc-save-later + snc-prev + snc-next present, snc-complete appears on last section. /special-needs/report renders snc-report-root with regenerate + download-pdf + cache-bar and all major report sections. Dashboard shows dashboard-snc-card linking to /special-needs/report when report exists, and dashboard-family-report-card is absent.
critical_code_review_comments: snc_routes.py returns Mongo docs cleanly (_id stripped in _serialize and via projection). Good.
Report cache uses replace_one with upsert on user_id — idempotent regeneration works correctly.
Report staleness derived from source_updated_at vs assessment.updated_at OR explicit stale flag. Solid.
PDF endpoint 404s before generation as designed. No PDF is regenerated on GET — only on POST /generate | /regenerate — good separation of concerns.
DELETE /api/snc/me deletes both assessment + cached report (verified). Good clean-up.
Type coercion for numeric-string Likert values in _coerce_value works and is unit-covered.
Frontend Dashboard card conditionally routes to /special-needs or /special-needs/report based on sncStatus?.has_report — verified in-browser.
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Also created ephemeral TEST_ui_* and TEST_snc_pdf_* users during runs.
seed_data_creation: For UI report render: 1) POST /api/snc/answers/bulk with full 92-item answer set + s11_flags='None of these apply.' 2) POST /api/snc/report/generate. Also stored localStorage['sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1']='true' before login to bypass the /orientation gate that otherwise blocks the dashboard route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SNC endpoints live at /api/snc/*. Dashboard requires the orientation flag in localStorage (sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1=true) plus dismissing the LegalAcknowledgment modal via [data-testid=legal-ack-checkbox] + [data-testid=legal-ack-continue-button] to reach /dashboard. The dashboard-snc-card links to /special-needs by default and to /special-needs/report once a cached report exists. Family Report endpoints (/api/family-report/status and /api/insights/family-report-dynamic-sample.pdf) correctly return 404 — do not treat this as a regression.
